From 5213a8db23f1768c974b41c15df9d1570f5f5147 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: allen <allen.chen@ite.com.tw>
Date: Mon, 27 Apr 2020 17:16:52 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] dt-bindings: fix vendor prefix for ITE Tech. Inc.

ITE Tech. Inc. (abbreviated as ITE ) is a professional fabless IC
design house. ITE's core technology includes PC and NB Controller chips,
Super I/O, High Speed Serial Interface, Video Codec, Touch Sensing,
Surveillance, OFDM, Sensor Fusion, and so on.

Our official name is "ITE Tech. Inc.", so change "ITE," to "ITE.".

more information on: http://www.ite.com.tw/

Signed-off-by: Allen Chen <allen.chen@ite.com.tw>
Acked-by: Rob Herring <robh@kernel.org>
Fixes: 17ff9478ffa3 ("dt-bindings: Add ITE Tech prefix")
Cc: Marek Vasut <marex@denx.de>
Cc: devicetree@vger.kernel.org
Cc: Allen Chen <allen.chen@ite.com.tw>
Signed-off-by: Sam Ravnborg <sam@ravnborg.org>
[added fixes tag and updated subject]
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/1587979103-5630-2-git-send-email-allen.chen@ite.com.tw

diff --git a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/vendor-prefixes.yaml b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/vendor-prefixes.yaml
index 31012f91fb9a..a129db1701e5 100644
--- a/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/vendor-prefixes.yaml
+++ b/Documentation/devicetree/bindings/vendor-prefixes.yaml
@@ -490,7 +490,7 @@ patternProperties:
   "^issi,.*":
     description: Integrated Silicon Solutions Inc.
   "^ite,.*":
-    description: ITE Tech, Inc.
+    description: ITE Tech. Inc.
   "^itead,.*":
     description: ITEAD Intelligent Systems Co.Ltd
   "^iwave,.*":
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `Documentation/devicetree/bindings/vendor-prefixes.yaml`**
   - The description for the vendor prefix `ite,` was changed from "ITE Tech, Inc." to "ITE Tech. Inc." This modification corrects the punctuation in the official name of the company.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The change in the vendor prefix description is a direct correction to a previously established entry for ITE Tech. Inc. in the device tree bindings documentation. This patch addresses a bug related to the incorrect representation of the company's name, ensuring that it reflects the official name accurately. The fix is linked to a prior commit (identified by the hash `17ff9478ffa3`) that added the ITE Tech prefix, indicating that this patch is a follow-up correction to that earlier addition.

1. analyze the root cause of the bug in detail.

Here is the commit message:
dt-bindings: fix vendor prefix for ITE Tech. Inc.

ITE Tech. Inc. (abbreviated as ITE ) is a professional fabless IC
design house. ITE's core technology includes PC and NB Controller chips,
Super I/O, High Speed Serial Interface, Video Codec, Touch Sensing,
Surveillance, OFDM, Sensor Fusion, and so on.

Our official name is "ITE Tech. Inc.", so change "ITE," to "ITE.".

more information on: http://www.ite.com.tw/

Signed-off-by: Allen Chen <allen.chen@ite.com.tw>
Acked-by: Rob Herring <robh@kernel.org>
Fixes: 17ff9478ffa3 ("dt-bindings: Add ITE Tech prefix")
Cc: Marek Vasut <marex@denx.de>
Cc: devicetree@vger.kernel.org
Cc: Allen Chen <allen.chen@ite.com.tw>
Signed-off-by: Sam Ravnborg <sam@ravnborg.org>
[added fixes tag and updated subject]
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/1587979103-5630-2-git-send-email-allen.chen@ite.com.tw

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by an incorrect punctuation in the vendor prefix description for ITE Tech. Inc., where "ITE," was used instead of the correct "ITE." This misrepresentation could lead to confusion or misidentification of the company in documentation and code references.

Here is the patch:
     description: Integrated Silicon Solutions Inc.
   "^ite,.*":
-    description: ITE Tech, Inc.
+    description: ITE Tech. Inc.
   "^itead,.*":
     description: ITEAD Intelligent Systems Co.Ltd

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```plaintext
"^ite,.*":
description: ITE Tech, Inc.
```
Reason:
The use of a comma in the vendor prefix ("ITE,") instead of a period ("ITE.") is incorrect and can lead to confusion or misidentification of the company in documentation and code references.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
"^ite,.*":
description: ITE Tech. Inc.
```
Reason:
The patch corrects the punctuation by replacing the comma with a period, ensuring that the vendor prefix accurately reflects the official name of the company, thereby preventing potential misrepresentation in documentation and code references.
